extras: Self-described as in its early stages with a roadmap of planned features (homepage, gallery view, database CRUD). Documentation is available in English and Simplified Chinese. The author requests GitHub stars and accepts sponsorships.
intentEvidence: Since the API of Dataview is used, the Dataview plugin must be enabled.
motivation: The author, a deep Obsidian user, found existing plugins did not meet their needs for search, review, and editing/deleting Dataview tables, so they built a new view system based on Ant Design.
problem: Dataview tables in Obsidian lack built-in search, filtering, aggregation, pagination, and editing/deleting of table content.
